<?php
class PendingThrowCache21 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; } }
function pendingThrowChild21() { echo "C|"; try { yield new PendingThrowCache21(); echo "BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CHILD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } return 17; }
function pendingThrowMiddle21() { global $child; echo "M|"; try { $result = yield from ($child = pendingThrowChild21()); echo "MR|", $result, "|"; return 23; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingThrowOuter21() { global $middle; echo "O|"; try { $result = yield from ($middle = pendingThrowMiddle21()); echo "OR|", $result, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
echo "P|"; $injected = new Exception("pending21"); $outer = pendingThrowOuter21(); $outer->rewind(); $held = $outer->current(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
try { $result = $middle->throw($injected); echo "RETURNED|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $injected ? "SAME|" : "OTHER|"; }
echo "V|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $child->key(), "|", $child->current() === $held ? "LIVE|" : "BAD|"; echo $middle->current() === $held ? "SHARED|" : "WRONG|";
unset($outer, $middle, $child); echo "CLOSED|"; unset($held); echo "END|"; unset($caught, $result, $injected); echo "E";
purpose: Pending native-link THROW first records exact caller catch versus child catch, preserved current/key/valid getters, and later finally/cache cleanup while an independent snapshot retains the cached object.
